title: Cascade Ortho Rider Certificate — When Rider Coverage Starts and Ends
content:
**Start and end of coverage under the Orthodontic Benefit Riders.**

- A rider becomes active on its rider effective date once the attached dental enrollment is active. It never starts before the dental enrollment.
- Withdrawing a rider application and ending a rider are the subscriber's own decisions. The agent registers a rider change request, and the change is carried out only after the subscriber confirms it.
- A rider withdrawal or voluntary rider termination is carried out only once the subscriber's rider change request for that rider is confirmed.
- An application may be withdrawn at any time before the rider effective date. Once the rider is active it can only be terminated, and premium for months already covered is not refunded.
- A voluntary termination ends the rider on the last day of the month in which the request is confirmed. It closes any open case with the reason "coverage ended" and starts the re-enrollment lockout.
- When the attached dental enrollment is withdrawn or cancelled, the applied rider is cancelled with it. When the dental enrollment terminates or is cancelled, the active rider terminates on the same termination date. In both cases this follows automatically and needs no request.
- A reinstated dental enrollment does not reinstate a rider that ended for any reason other than the dental termination being reversed. When a dental termination for nonpayment is reversed by reinstatement, the rider is restored with it.

## Rider statuses

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| applied | accepted, not yet effective |
| active | coverage in force |
| cancelled | the application was withdrawn before the effective date, or the dental application was withdrawn or cancelled |
| terminated | coverage ended, either with the dental enrollment or by the subscriber's voluntary termination |

## The confirmation record

A voluntary termination is carried out only when the system record shows the subscriber's rider change request for that same rider with the status "confirmed".

*Hypothetical example:* a request confirmed on 17 May ends the rider on 31 May. Any open case is closed as "coverage ended", and the lockout runs from 31 May.
